prompt: Create GlobalErrorHandler with AnalyticsService, provideBrowserGlobalErrorListeners, and tests with rethrowApplicationErrors

assertions.name: error-handler-implements-interface
assertions.description: GlobalErrorHandler class implements ErrorHandler interface with handleError(error: unknown) method

assertions.name: inject-router-for-url
assertions.description: Uses inject(Router) to get current URL for error context, not constructor injection

assertions.name: provide-browser-global-listeners
assertions.description: App config includes provideBrowserGlobalErrorListeners() in providers

assertions.name: error-handler-provider
assertions.description: App config provides ErrorHandler via { provide: ErrorHandler, useClass: GlobalErrorHandler }

assertions.name: catch-no-catch-documentation
assertions.description: Comments explain Angular catches: component lifecycle, template events, AsyncPipe, PendingTasks.run; does NOT catch: service methods, resource() errors

assertions.name: inject-function-usage
assertions.description: Uses inject() function for DI throughout, not constructor injection
